newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady, mood lifeless.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady, mood lifeless.

text.p: Rubber futures closed steady on Thursday in dreary trade with most players marking time in the absence of heavy buying that could lift the market out of its current stupor, dealers said.
"It was more of the same kind of trading - dull, dull, dull," one local rubber trader said. "With little offtake in the works, there was really nothing that could push the market higher."
Listless Japanese prices added to the gloomy mood, dealers said. Tokyo's benchmark February contract rose by just 0.3 yen to 139.6 while Kobe's February contract dipped 0.2 yen to 139.6.
"The ring sessions were zero again. Conditions were pretty much dead today," another dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 was seen at 128.50-129.00 U.S. cents a kg from 128.50 cents.
November RSS1 was seen at 184.00-186.00 Singapore cents (US$1.30-$1.32) a kg from Wednesday's settlement of 185.00 cents.
November TSR20 was seen unchanged at 179.00 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg.
